LoRA 8/16, B4/card, model owners, loss and optimizer remain unchanged. A new
actor loads the captured trainable shards; frozen base and optimizer runtime
are not restored. Record PEFT mode restoration at existing RPC boundaries.
No tensor observations or extra head calls are made before native loss. Only
the second B4 is captured after its loss gradient is computed. If nonfinite,
read the actual head autograd context for diagnosis; do not replay a head.
